append.detail: lib/unlocks.ts is the one declarative map (feature, stage floor, role floor). The feed and the practice board read their stage reveals from it, and the Outreach, Inbox, View as and member-support gates read their host floor from it. docs/UNLOCKS.md is generated from the map (pnpm unlocks:doc) and lib/unlocks.test.ts fails when they drift. The stage ladder's keys now come from the map too.
